snippet.title: Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking - DEBUT TRAILER
snippet.description:
Play along for the final weeks of development during our Open Playtest on Steam NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/

In this absurd co-op horror game you are medieval monks--and the only chefs who can prevent the apocalypse. Feed enormous monsters with a catapult, evade supernatural enemies, and navigate a reality-bending labyrinth with up to 4+ players!

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/
PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/StrangeScaffold
DISCORD: https://discordapp.com/invite/YySjWvM
BLUESKY: https://bsky.app/profile/strangescaffold.bsky.social
